args: if go vet ./internal/mutation >&2; then echo '{"version":"invaris.validity-result/v1alpha1","status":"VALID"}'; else echo '{"version":"invaris.validity-result/v1alpha1","status":"INVALID"}'; exit 1; fi

out=$(go test -count=1 ./internal/mutation 2>&1); rc=$?; fails=0; tests=''; sep=''
for t in TestPlanGoldens TestPlanIneligibleInputs TestValidate; do
  if printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -- "--- FAIL: $t"; then s=ASSERTION_FAILED; fails=1; else s=PASS; fi
  tests="$tests$sep{\"id\":\"$t\",\"status\":\"$s\"}"; sep=,
done
if [ $rc -ne 0 ] && [ $fails -eq 0 ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi
printf '{"version":"invaris.test-result/v1alpha1","tests":[%s]}\n' "$tests"
exit $fails
